Definition: from G2596 and G3708; to behold fully, i.e. (figuratively) distinctly apprehend:--clearly see.
BiblicalUsage: Kathorao means to see clearly, to take something in fully. Romans 1:20 says the invisible things of God from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe creation leaves no one an excuse, because God made himself plain to see in what he made.
